issue.title: macros.md %auto row is stale: bare %auto archives tale plans, auto-answers questions, and launches epics
issue.description:
The core `macros.md` directive table row for `%auto` reads: "`%auto[:plan/tale/epic]`
| `%a` | Auto-approve next plan; `tale`/`epic` commit SDD then launch follow-up". That is
stale in two ways, verified on master 142636c528:

1. Bare `%auto` also archives tale plans. Since 005f431eb8 (2026-07-18), the tale gate's
   primary branch has been `[approve, commit]` with every option default_selected, and
   `resolve_auto_selection` returns that branch. All 557 auto-resolved tale plan bundles
   under ~/.sase/interaction_requests/plan with a recorded selection chose
   `approve`+`commit`. The June fix a3e494d938 ("keep auto plan approvals
   non-committing") no longer describes current behavior.
2. `%auto` is not plan-only. It auto-resolves question gates (first option), and
   `is_auto_approve_active()` treats any stored argument, including `:tale`/`:epic`, as
   active. It also auto-approves and launches epic plans.

Every agent loads this row as core memory, so it misleads them about what `%auto` grants.
docs/macros.md (Auto Directive section and the `%auto:epic` paragraph at ~3204) has the
same drift and should be corrected in the same change.

Evidence and context: research:202610/auto_directive_autonomy_policy/auto_directive_autonomy_policy__final.md
(defects D3/D4).

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Rewrite the %auto table row to describe gate auto-resolution: bare %auto approves and archives tale plans (same as Enter), approves and launches epic plans, and answers questions with the first option; :tale/:epic restrict which plan tier may auto-resolve and still auto-answer questions; launch/sudo/custom gates are never auto-resolved.

issue.creation_reason: Core memory tells every agent that %auto only auto-approves the next plan and that only tale/epic commit, which no longer matches observed gate behavior.
